<!-- maul:notice maul/beatbattle-44 verify-replan-r3 -->
maul now verifies this Project's changes with its agent evaluator, which checks acceptance outcomes stated in plain words and writes its own checks. The approved plan r3 states acceptance criteria instead, which the evaluator does not run, so nothing is verified for this intent. The approved plan cannot change while its pull requests are open, so its pull requests are reviewed as they are. To have the change verified instead, an approver comments `/maul cancel` (the pull requests are left to you) and opens a new issue with the `maul:intent` label, which maul plans afresh with outcomes.
